Subject: Request: subprocessor inventory + gap analysis for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this—Acme Health is starting a SIG/CAIQ-led review tied to our upcoming vendor re-certification. Our security team has requested a concise subprocessor inventory and a short "gap analysis" showing where evidence exists (SOC 2, contracts, attestations) versus where we need additional artifacts (KMS ownership, onshore processing, SOC reports).

Specifically can you provide: 
- A CSV with the current subprocessor roster (roles, region, data processed, contract link)
- Any SOC 2 / ISO / third-party attestations you can share or attest to in writing
- A short note on KMS ownership/key separation for any subprocessor that handles encrypted customer data
- Target ETA for a SIG evidence bundle (PDF/zip) we can ingest into our assessment portal

We understand some items may be redacted; please flag redactions and provide the rationale. We need an initial inventory by Friday 18 Sep and the evidence bundle by 24 Sep if possible.

Appreciate it—let me know if you prefer a quick sync.

Best,
Megan

Megan / team—quick technical clarifications and what we'll include in the evidence pack: 

1) KMS / key separation:
- Redwood uses customer-managed KMS for Private deployments when requested; for hosted customers we use a multi-tenant KMS model with envelope encryption.
- The attached key_access_matrix_v1.pdf maps which subprocessors have any potential access to ciphertext or decryption endpoints. For any vendor that could access plaintext (eg, managed support for a storage endpoint), we include the minimal justification and control evidence.

2) SOC 2 / attestations:
- We will include our most recent SOC 2 Type II summary and the redacted report excerpts. Where a subprocessor maintains its own SOC, we link to the attestation if public or include the excerpt.

3) Dataflow and onshore flags:
- The CSV includes a column 'env_scope' (prod/dev) and 'region'. We'll flag non-prod-only subprocessors with "dev-only" so you can exclude them if needed.

4) Evidence delivery:
- Draft evidence will be uploaded to a shared Drive folder (link below) as separate PDFs and a consolidated zip (sig_evidence_pack.zip). We will also include a short README that documents redactions and justification.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExample

If you want specific attestations submitted directly to Acme's portal, copy me on the upload and we can coordinate automated transfer.

Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
